summary: Keep missing launch inputs path-scoped and re-evaluate only declarations whose inputs changed

schema.detail: Watch dependencies and pending launch evaluations remain in memory. Performance counters add scoped_launch_notifications and scoped_launch_evaluations.

compatibility.detail: Missing nested input watches retain their full declared path instead of accepting all writes below the first missing component. Ancestor creation and replacement still refresh coverage. Launch-input changes use the dependency follower instead of waking a full reconcile pass; genuine lost-event rescans still fail closed.

downtime.detail: Only the normal binary deployment restart.

manual.detail: No configuration or state repair is required.

recovery.detail: No persistent format changes; normal restart reconstructs subscriptions and dependencies.
